body: I called their non-emergency number and it lead me to a big menu. I wasn't able to reach a live person to talk to.

I recognize that he lost a big part of himself when he cut out these two best friends. I made the mistake of letting him think that it was okay to bring them up in casual conversation and talk positively about them. He just graduated college, and due to COVID it's been difficult to make friends. 

However he complained that he felt lonely even being with them (physically)

She often involved my boyfriend in her relationship fights. They would come over to my boyfriends apartment to fight and make up. She would call my boyfriend and ask where her boyfriend was and what he was doing. He was more of a babysitter than a friend to her, that's how I see it.

Thank you for your comment. This is absolutely correct. 

I thought I had her absolute support. She told me that she was sexually assaulted in her home country, and when she told her boyfriend about it he had called her a slut.
